item.title: Innefu Labs Raises $30M Series B — India's Sovereign-AI Push
item.description: New Delhi national-security AI firm Innefu Labs has raised USD 30 million (about Rs 286 crore) in a Series B round led by Panthera Growth Partners, with plans for an Agentic AI platform, a Physical AI robotics wing, global expansion and an eventual IPO. What the deal means for India's sovereign deep-tech sector.

item.title: FortiBleed: 30,000+ Fortinet Firewalls Hijacked — India Is 60% of the Government Hits
item.description: FortiBleed is a live credential-harvesting campaign that has compromised tens of thousands of internet-facing Fortinet firewalls and VPN gateways worldwide — and India accounts for over 60% of the government devices in the attacker's database. What happened, which CVEs are being exploited, the forensic traces, and an immediate defensive playbook for Indian organisations.

item.title: CERT-In's 12-Hour Patch Rule: India's Answer to AI-Speed Attacks (2026)
item.description: CERT-In's new 38-page blueprint urges Indian organisations to patch known-exploited, internet-facing vulnerabilities within 12 hours as AI collapses the time attackers need to find and exploit flaws. The full risk-based remediation timeline, what it means for Indian security teams, and a practical compliance playbook.

item.title: Kali365: The Microsoft 365 Phishing Kit That Bypasses MFA (FBI Warning, 2026)
item.description: The FBI has warned about Kali365, a Phishing-as-a-Service kit that hijacks Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing the OAuth device code flow — bypassing MFA without stealing a password. How it works, why it defeats MFA, the forensic traces it leaves, and a defensive playbook for Indian organisations and users.
